blind.B1: Yes. Voluntary wheel running (3 weeks, locked-wheel controls; S1.2.p1, S0.p7). Exercise-carrying samples: GEO activity=Exercise, 8 samples (O(+Ex) 5, Y(+Ex) 3), with 13 sedentary (O 7, Y 6) as controls = 21 samples (2016 submission). The 15 Ccnd1 genotype samples (2018 submission) are a separate non-exercise experiment (S0.p15).
blind.B2: O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex) (248 DEGs, S0.p7), Y(+Ex) vs Y(-Ex) (35 DEGs), O(-Ex) vs Y(-Ex) as the aging reference (130 of 248 rejuvenated). Group sizes from GEO: OEx 5, OSed 7, YEx 3, YSed 6; the paper text does not give RNA-seq n per group (Fig 2 legend gives only RT-qPCR n).
blind.B3: None: each profile is MuSCs from an individual mouse (S1.19.p1, Fig 2a legend). No repeated sampling; no pairing key needed (candidate keys in packet A are only title-derived and not animal IDs).
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint versus pairwise. S1.19.p3: RUVs k=6 on raw counts, edgeR with Cox-Reid tagwise dispersion and NB GLM likelihood ratio tests, BH q-values.
blind.B5: S0.p7: 'At a 10% false discovery rate (FDR)'; S1.19.p3: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values; no fold-change cutoff stated. Counts: 248 (O+Ex vs O-Ex), 35 (Y+Ex vs Y-Ex); Ccnd1 top hit; 633/530 for the Ccnd1 HET/KO series (not exercise).

checks.evidence: Run on exercise arm (8 Ex samples); Ccnd1 genotype series excluded with reason (S0.p15); matches B1.
grp OSed 7 / OEx 5 / YSed 6 / YEx 3 equals the GEO titles and activity/age columns; 15 exclusions named with reason; control for each contrast is the matching-age sedentary group.
Contrasts OEx vs OSed, YEx vs YSed, OSed vs YSed with treatment first; Ccnd1 up with exercise (log2FC +1.14) and lower in old than young, as in S0.p9.
One mouse per profile (S1.19.p1; Fig 2a legend); no blocking needed.

Paper silent (B4). Joint limma cell-means model only; DEG counts are 4-12x the paper (1064 vs 248, 442 vs 35) and no pairwise fit is reported next to it. Likely cause is the RUVs k=6 factors not being modelled, which is recorded as a caveat.
checks.fix: Optionally add a pairwise-subset limma fit per contrast as a sensitivity run.

checks.evidence: All 21 exercise samples from one 2016 submission, male, same strain; individually housed in both arms (S1.2.p1); no batch column. RUVs batch factors unavailable, recorded.

Deposited table is RUVs-normalized FPKM (GEO data_processing), correctly sent to limma on log2(x+1) not edgeR; p-value histogram right-skewed (frac p<0.05 0.26/0.19, frac p>0.9 ~0.06), consistent with inflation noted. Minor: reasoning quotes median ~5.8 vs profile median 6.04, and 11,332 vs 11,337 genes (5 duplicate symbols), both explained.
padj<0.1 with no FC cutoff, BH, matches B5; audit 0.05 recorded separately; no other rule in the packet table fits 248/35 (nearest padj<0.05 with |lfc|>1 gives 10/8, far off).
Same contrasts at the same rule; HANDBACK states 1064 vs 248 and 442 vs 35 openly and discloses GSEA direction conflicts (E2F/G2M, IFN); no overclaim.
No stop or refusal; edgeR route recorded as blocked because raw counts and RUVs W are not deposited, which is true (supplementary_file NONE, only the FPKM table).

human_items: Joint versus pairwise fits when the paper is silent (open policy question); DEG counts differ 4-12x from the paper.
Which threshold to report is not in question here: no alternative rule reproduces 248/35.
summary: 该案例的样本分组、对比方向、阈值（BH FDR 10%，无倍数变化阈值）和矩阵路线（RUVs标准化FPKM走limma）均与论文一致，每个样本是独立小鼠，无需配对。DEG数量比论文多4到12倍，原因是RUVs因子未入模，已作为偏差记录；联合模型与分对模型的选择属于开放政策问题，仅作次要提示。
